note: Lassen NF (Almanor RD) campground in conifer forest beside the Domingo Spring meadow and Domingo Creek, 8 miles NW of Chester off Warner Valley/Old Bluff Rd and less than half a mile from the Pacific Crest Trail. The area burned heavily in past wildfires, and the Forest Service says sites 15-18 may still be closed off for hazard trees. The Forest Service posts no rig length. --Claude
summary: Domingo Springs (Lassen NF): FS page + alerts + rec.gov search + USGS topo + Esri. $14, 2 vehicles / 8 people, 18 sites, May-Sep, vault + potable, first-come (no rec.gov listing) all confirmed; 14-night limit added from the forest order. Riverfront -> not waterfront lead (the stream is Domingo Creek, a few m wide, ~45-50 m off across forest edge and wet meadow, loop road between, under canopy). Phone added.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (downgrade, riverfront -> not waterfront): the stored value and note name the North Fork Feather River, but the stream at the campground is Domingo Creek on the USGS topo - a spring-fed channel a few metres wide (creek size, never riverfront) running east from Domingo Spring through an open wet meadow. The one loop sits under continuous conifer canopy; its north road is ~45-50 m south of the channel with the forest edge and wet meadow between, and no pad can be seen or named (no site map exists). Under canopy with no site map an on-water value can't be shown, and the loop road lies between the interior sites and the creek, so by the default-down rule it goes to 'not waterfront' (there is no creek-view value). The old evidence ('sites ~30-50m from the channel across unused grass apron') was not borne out: the imagery shows forest, not an apron, between the loop and the meadow. Proposed evidence: 'USGS topo + Esri 2026-11-26 at 40.3603,-121.3462: loop under dense conifers, Domingo Creek (a few m wide) ~45-50 m N across forest edge and wet meadow, loop road between, no pads visible -> not waterfront. --Claude'
STATUS (not set): the FS page says sites #15-#18 'may still be closed off with hazard trees' after past wildfires; carried in the note, not a closure of the campground.
PHONE: empty -> (530) 258-2141 (Almanor Ranger District, on the FS page).
SITES: no rig length posted anywhere; FS calls it 'a developed campground with 18 designated sites'. Kept with the 'no rig length' caveat in the note.
PIN: stored 40.36055,-121.34748 is the FS coordinate at the loop's entrance by Domingo Spring; the loop centre (~40.3602,-121.3465) is ~100 m away - no move.
